{{ModBox}} '''Quickdraw''' is a pistol mod that increases [[reload speed]]. ==Stats== {| class="emodtable" |+ Normal |- ! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! Effect ! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]] |- | 0 || +8% || 2 |- | 1 || +16% || 3 |- | 2 || +24% || 4 |- | 3 || +32% || 5 |- | 4 || +40% || 6 |- | 5 || +48% || 7 |}
{| class="emodtable" |+ [[Flawed Mods|Flawed]] |- ! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! Effect ! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]] |- | 0 || +5% || 2 |- | 1 || +10% || 3 |- | 2 || +15% || 4 |- | 3 || +20% || 5 |} ==Drop Locations== {{DropLocations}} ==Notes== *The calculation of reload time using reload speed is: {{MathText|Reload Time {{eql}} Base Reload Time {{div}} (1 + Reload Speed Bonus)}} *At max rank, expect a 33% reduction to reload times. 1/(1 + 0.48) ~ (2/3 of original reload speed) *Stacking this with {{M|Stunning Speed}} should reduce reload times by 47% (or 53% of base reload speed) ==Trivia== *Prior to {{ver|16.7}}, this mod was usable in [[PvP]] games until it was replaced by its own specific PvP mods along with a number of other mods: {{M|Fast Hands}}, {{M|Slip Magazine}}, {{M|Tactical Pump}}, {{M|Steady Hands}}, {{M|Stabilizer}}, {{M|Burdened Magazine}}, {{M|Magazine Warp}} and {{M|Terminal Velocity}}. ==Gallery== QuickdrawModOld.png|Old appearance ==See also== *{{M|Primed Quickdraw}}, the [[prime]]d version that [[Baro Ki'Teer]] offers. *{{M|Fast Hands}}, the rifle version of this mod. *{{M|Tactical Pump}}, the shotgun version of this mod. *{{M|Stunning Speed}}, a [[:Category:Nightmare Mode Mods|Nightmare Mod]] which also increases status chance. ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|Vanilla}} *Introduced. }} {{ReloadSpeedModsNav}} __NOTOC__ [[de:Schnelles Ziehen]] [[es:Agarre rápido]] [[pt:Quickdraw]] [[ru:Быстрохват]] [[Category:Mods]] [[Category:Pistol Mods]] [[Category:Common Mods]] [[Category:Naramon Mods]] [[Category:Flawed Mods]] [[uk:Швидке перезаряджання]] [[Category:Update 14]]

{{ModBox}}
The '''Point Blank''' mod increases the base damage of a [[:Category:Shotgun|shotgun]] by 15% per rank at a maximum of 90% at rank 5.

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
* Affects base damage which is applied before every other damage type. Therefore, every other damage increasing mod is benefiting from Point Blank as well.
**This mod combined with {{M|Vicious Spread}} and {{M|Blaze}} give off a total damage increase of +240%.
**With {{M|Primed Point Blank}} instead of '''Point Blank''', this adds up for a total damage increase of +315% with Vicious Spread and Blaze.
* Due to how it affects the base damage, this mod is necessary for all shotgun weapons in order to use them optimally. Few mods can replace the effectiveness of this mod.{{clr}}
